items.stem: Why is follower count alone a weak measure of social media success?

options.text: It does not show engagement or impact on business goals
options.rationale: Correct: a large but inactive or irrelevant audience adds little value.
They are countable; they are just a weak success measure alone.
They often do not; that is the point of the critique.

items.explanation: Correct: a large but inactive or irrelevant audience adds little value.

items.stem: A brand wants to build an engaged community, not just an audience. Which TWO practices support that? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Respond to and converse with followers, not only broadcast
options.rationale: Correct: two-way interaction builds community and belonging.
Correct: involving members deepens engagement and ownership.

options.text: Delete all negative comments on sight
options.rationale: Silencing feedback erodes trust; thoughtful responses build it.

items.explanation: Correct: converse with the community and involve members through UGC.

items.stem: A customer posts a public complaint. What is the best first response?

options.text: Reply publicly, acknowledge the issue, and move to resolve it
options.rationale: Correct: a prompt, calm public acknowledgement builds trust and shows others you care.

options.text: Ignore it so it fades away
Argue publicly that the customer is wrong
options.rationale: Public arguments escalate and harm the brand.

items.explanation: Correct: a prompt, calm public acknowledgement builds trust and shows others you care.
